My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone. It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds. Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before. - C Rewards You will receive: Ruby-Adorned Blade Experience: 3,450 When you come back <The chest sits, empty.> When you hand it in <You place The Eye of Bhossca into the chest>

86667.desc: My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic. I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold. When you come back Eh? What do you want? When you hand it in This jar is for me? Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for! A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person. Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.

88756.desc: The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents. I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder! I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em! Rewards You will receive: 5 Ez-Thro Dynamite Money: 30 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,550 +100 reputation with Ironforge When you come back This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on! When you hand it in Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire. Now we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry! Thanks!

88757.desc: While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear! It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things! If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.

88917.desc: I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts. The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak. A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage. I need your help to get that staff, ‹race›. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.

89038.desc: It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime. As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now. Rewards Money: 40 0 gold, 40 silver, 0 copper Experience: 5,650

91754.desc: I haven't seen |5‹race› like you in years! Oh, I don't know what to do! My friend Fraxinus is sick, and I can't leave him alone! Could you please fetch me some Untainted Soil from the uncorrupted land southeast of here? I can make some poultices that may help him to feel better.

92011.desc: I'm going to need some time to sort out which plans to build first. Something I've been meaning to do is hike up to the old Horde base and see what kind of treasure can be made out of whatever trash is laying around there. If you are heading up there, and have the space to carry it, keep your eyes peeled for scrap metal, wire, or chunks of bat... droppings! Look, it has its uses okay! You can find the remains of the horde encampment far up the mountain, even beyond the Elderwild settlement. Rewards You will receive: Power Recycler Experience: 6,200

92335.desc: This magic you seek is as complex as it is wild. It needs a reagent that can provide a stable source of continual energy, and I know of just the thing. When Archimonde met his well-deserved end here, many of his lesser minions were also killed. His chief lieutenant, Azgalor, was slain--by mortals like you, no less! You'll find the last physical remains of Azgalor in the middle of the ruins here. No need to bring all of that ash back to Ketharas. Just a pinch should be more than enough for his needs.

92500.desc: Since the shrine of Aviana has fallen into disrepair, the Wormwing harpies have snuck in and stolen the last of our druidic relics. One of these, the Jewel of the Horizon, is a sparkling blue stone blessed by the feathered goddess herself. The touch of Aviana may have just the magical power that you need for your task. The Wormwings have doubtless hidden it in or near one of their nests. When you find it, take it to Ketharas.

92702.desc: <Fenwick struggles to rock back and forth and gain some swaying motion.> Hey! Hey you! Grab a stick and see if you can reach me, please? I've been stuck here so long my suspenders are chafing! I've got good things--GREAT things--to share with you! Fenwick Togglespring never gives false promises! It's my rusty brother back at the launch pad who clearly miscalculated a few things in our rocket launch capabilities! He's mister false promises! <Fenwick fails to grab an object out of reach.>

92749.desc: Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention! We'll start with some dynamite... Rewards Money: 4 0 gold, 4 silver, 0 copper Experience: 575 +50 reputation with Stormwind When you come back Show me those explosives, ‹name›! When you hand it in This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...

93407.desc: We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature. Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses. Rewards Money: 70 0 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper Experience: 6,600

93450.desc: Being corporeal has its challenges, as you know, but being INcorporeal is a whole other situation. Will I fall through THIS chair? Will I trip over THAT cat? Worst of all, however, it makes everyday work impossible! Do you see this sword on my anvil? I began work on this thousands of years ago, but met my demise before it was finished. Now it taunts me, AND takes up precious real estate! I cannot work with it! I cannot MOVE it! I need you to help, uh, "ferry" it to the spirit realm. What do you say?

93546.desc: Finally, FINALLY I can use this anvil for something other than a monumentally heavy table. I am delighted to finally hone my craft again after centuries of missed practice. Now, you are probably thinking, "Vindael, this sounds like you are setting the stage for another request." And you would be correct! I need to replenish my supply of iron, but your iron has a similar predicament to my blade. Fortunately, the solution is MUCH simpler. <He hands you a ghostly pickaxe, without a chance to refuse.>

93604.desc: Big ‹race› heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it. Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history! Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could! Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood! Give blood, get necklace, win. Rewards Money: 65 0 gold, 65 silver, 0 copper Experience: 10,200

93606.desc: Quolga the Wise is Kog'thug's life mate. Quolga great thornweaver, that why Kog'thug like her. Quolga also has necklace Big ‹race› seeks. Problem? We not on squealing terms. She mad we stole necklace in first place. Then why use it? That what Kog'thug want know! BUT! Quolga like flowers as much as thorns. Know where we can get flowers? Where we got necklace! Maybe she not be mad at Kog'thug if Big ‹race› bring flowers and this blood for him? Maybe she trade necklace! Tell her Kog'thug sorry. Rewards You will receive: Forlorn Necklace Rejected Roses Experience: 3,900

93609.desc: <The necklace you have been seeking is at last in your possession, but unfortunately the magic contained within has been entirely depleted. While not ideal for your current situation, at least it made its acquisition from the quilboar relatively easy. It is probably best to bring this back to Mithera.> Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Amulet of Vengeance Amulet of Forgiveness Money: 1 30 1 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 4,850

93825.desc: You wish to learn from us? The trees of Hyjal speak to us. Their bark holds life, and on it grows the moss we call Moonveil. It is soft, green, and strong with the mountain's soul. We need this moss to heal our hurt and bless roots. Go, gentle one. Seek the old trees where the mist clings and the sun hides. Take Moonveil moss from their bark and bring it back to me. With it, we will mend what pains us.

93831.desc: You smell like mountain winds, strong and free! I have a task, if your paws are not full. We love bear berries, they're round, red, and sweet as honey after frost. Look for them near the shade of trees. Too many sharp rocks and mad wings for us to get the ripest bush. Bring me a bunch, and I make Sweetpaw Jam! My best treat, and I will share a taste. Deal? Rewards You will receive: 4 Sweetpaw Jam Experience: 4,500 +200 reputation with Barkskin Burrow

need: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
94004.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Wut? When you hand it in You brought da elixir!! T'anks, ‹race›. You come all this way to help Sos'mol. No ogre ever done that before. Sos'mol will remember this. Pay you back someday. Me promise.

94214.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Heyo, for future reference, you shouldn't come charging at full-speed toward a goblin with a bodyguard! You never know what might happen. When you hand it in Then again, when you're fulfilling a rush order like this one, I can't blame you for wanting to capitalize on your gains. Here you go, pal. Thanks for hooking a goblin up with some much-needed shadow protection potions. Have you SEEN the stuff that goes on out here?

94215.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Free Action Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <You approach a thrashing creature clearly trapped in spider silk, at the precise location the writ indicated.> When you hand it in <You waste little time offering the wiggling mass the Free Action Potion that was requested. It seems either unaware of your presence, or unable to claim the item. A handful of coins are scattered just beside the cocoon. You may decide to leave the potion there, and take the coins for yourself. Nature will surely sort itself out, in that case.>

need: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir
94217.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Yarr, you be bringin' me my elixir? When you hand it in Exactly what Short John Mithril ordered! Here's ye' coin. I'd keep it clutched to your chest as ye' scuttle out of here, the arena combatants thirst for riches as much as they thirst for blood!

94218.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Defense, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back If YOU are the assassin that the crewmen keep warning me about, well, you had better think twice before charging at ME, buster! When you hand it in Oh, oh!! The elixir! My, oh my. I am so sorry to have lashed out at you like that. I've been on edge ever since I was told that one of those goblins has supposedly put out a hit on me! Sadly I cannot afford additional security, so the best I can do is chug one of these and hope for the best. Cheers!

need: Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing
94219.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Draught of Water Breathing, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back If you're a customer, I got bad news for you. Some dwarf bought out the last of my stock! I'm waiting on supplies from afar now. If you want empty vials though, you've come to the right place! When you hand it in Water breathing draughts are a necessity if you plan to camp out here during the rainy nights. I tend to take my naps under that bridge over there, but sometimes the underside gets flooded. Now, I can sleep easy knowing my nightmares of drowning are only just nightmares. Come to think of it, I probably should have ordered some to resell...

94220.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Pearl-Handled Dagger, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back It is unwise to sneak up on me, ‹race›. Speak quickly, and speak quietly. When you hand it in Oh, you are delivering my dagger? Hah, I suppose my threat rang quite hollow then, hm? I must stay on high alert given my duties here, and especially with oth-- ahem, the foul Syndicate roaming about elsewhere here. Would you be so kind as to part with the blade, now? I must get back to my task.

94221.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Golden Rod, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <The dwarf seems to be in a deep state of meditation, though your approach interrupted his focus. Fortunately, a smile greets you.> When you hand it in Ah, the Golden Rod I requested. I never expected it to arrive. I was considering going back to Ironforge to purchase one off the auction house. You saved me a trip, something these old feet greatly thank you for. I do not yet know how I can use this to commune with the Binding Stones, let alone if I even can, but I suspect this brings me one step closer. In the worst case, well, I am happy to have a new cane.

94222.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Iridescent Hammer, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94223.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <After following the instructions on the writ, you find yourself deep in a crypt surrounded by undead. There is a note on a nearby trunk.> Whoever first reads this will be the first to learn of my death. I am a mere caretaker of the Raven Hill Cemetery, whose presence is largely forgotten by even his employers at Darkshire. I have no heir upon whom to bestow my vast wealth. I have since stashed it away, in this box, for who or whatever manages to open it. When you hand it in <With the undead hordes endlessly gathering nearby and no sign of others, you choose to make use of your Silver Skeleton Key to effortlessly open the chest. Despite the claims of impressive riches, the trunk is nearly empty. At the very least there is enough present to cover some of the cost of this ordeal.>

94224.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet. When you hand it in Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.

94225.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Rough Bronze Leggings, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back What's up? When you hand it in These are the leggings I ordered, huh? "Three to five business days," they said. More like three to five business MONTHS! I submitted this when I was working for the Venture Co out there, and let me just say, that partnership is well over with, so we can consider this order expired. Why aren't you leaving yet? Ugh, fine! Here's your payment.

94226.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Green Iron Gauntlets, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94227.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Big Bronze Knife, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <The chicken... clears its throat?> Cluck, cluck. When you hand it in Cluck? CLUCK CLUCK! BWOK! <The chicken glares menacingly toward Magus Tirth from afar, newly acquired blade in beak.>

94228.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Please tell me you're the one with the boots... When you hand it in At last! I've been stomping around the wetlands with soggy feet for days! Hopefully these aren't prone to rusting either. I trust you know what you're doing.

94229.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> When you come back Whoa! I almost didn't see you there. I might have seen you coming sooner if a damned engineer would at last deliver my order. When you hand it in Oh. Oh! You're the engineer? I suppose at the very least you are the delivery boy in any case. Please hand over the spyglass. I have little time and many things to inspect.

94230.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Explosive Sheep, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <The distraught woman peers into the nearby farmstead. She notices you approach a moment before it might have startled her.> Please tell me you are delivering one of my crafting orders! When you hand it in The Explosive Sheep? It's a bit smaller than I had hoped but... <She reached out to claim it, but then cautiously took it out from your arms. It did not take long before she delicately placed it down.> I'm hoping this does enough damage to scare a few off...

94231.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Moonsight Rifle, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Hey, HEY, man, haven't you heard of a little thing called "subtlety"? Spell it out with me, S-U-B...LETY. You're going to blow my cover! When you hand it in Ohoho, I take it back. Look at this beautiful boomstick. I bet it'll knock a satyr's head clean off. Thanks pal, now step aside or you're going to get caught in the crossfire.

94232.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Minor Recombobulator, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Do we have business? When you hand it in I don't know what I expected when I sent out an order for a curse dispelling device, but this Minor Recon--Racom--ugh, Minor Whatchamacallit sure ain't it! Look, I know how complicated the refund process is and I do NOT have time for that. It's way easier for us both if I just take this off your hands, and I'll be more specific with my next order. For both of our sakes, let's hope you don't screw that one up too!

94234.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Shadow Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Hey! Watch where you're walking! When you hand it in My new shadow goggles! <Without another word, the goblin tossed a handful of coins your way with one hand while the other swiped the item out of your grasp. The transaction was completed and his attention lost before you had a moment to process what happened.>

94235.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Gnomish Universal Remote, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Careful where you walk, Gizmo! This thing likes to activate when you least expect it, and we don't quite have a handle on where it can take you when we aren't actively manning the controls. When you hand it in Seems we are in luck, the remote has arrived! Looks like you precalibrated it for us which, I'll admit, isn't ideal for this scenario. I should be able to reverse engineer it in no time. Then maybe, hopefully, I'll be able to take a much needed break. Feels like I've been stuck fumbling with this teleporter's controls for months on end!

94236.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Big Bronze Bomb, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back You got the stuff? When you hand it in Hey, there's the bomb I ordered! Well, one of them anyway. I needed a variety pack! You know, enough so I can test each one for effectiveness AND have a few leftover for my own needs! Well, whatever. Here's a cut of your cut, I'll give you the rest when you bring ME my full order!

94237.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 200 Crafted Solid Shot, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Here to buy, or sell? When you hand it in I am glad you arrived when you did. A few Dragonmaw orcs stormed by the other day and gave me the stink eye. I ran out of ammunition on my way here. It's half the reason I haven't left this wretched place yet! The other half being that I still have profits to make. <Kixxle greedily rubs his hands.>

94238.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Heavy Leather Ball, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94239.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Fine Leather Pants, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Move along, please, and try not to draw attention to us. When you hand it in Oh! The pants? Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included. If it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. After all, you did make an arduous journey to find me. Take this, now please... <She gestured in a polite but firm shooing motion.>

94240.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Herbalist's Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94242.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Pilferer's Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94243.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Heavy Quiver, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Need some work? When you hand it in I--Hmm. I don't remember why I ordered this. <Ziz shrugs and tosses the quiver into a nearby pile of junk.>

94244.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Dark Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Yarr, what business do ye' have with ol' Narkk? When you hand it in Thar be me shoulderpads, at last! Ever had one of these squakers perch on your shoulder? Bet ye' haven't! Their claws, they hurt! Now they got a place to rest all day, and you have a heavier coinpurse! <Narkk eyes said coinpurse.> For now!

94245.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Barbaric Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Sign-ups are closed, bud. Besides, you look a little too big to fit in one of our carts. When you hand it in Oh, thank gold my new gloves FINALLY arrived. You have no idea how long I have been waiting for these. All these other gobs insist on working barehanded, but that's how you lose a fingernail. Or a finger! <The pit boss swiftly removes his old grimy gloves and swipes his new pair right out of your hands.>

94246.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Red Whelp Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics

94247.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Lesser Wizard's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <The man stands at attention, peering over the mountainside toward Dalaran. He regards your presence with a subtle wave of a hand, beckoning you closer.> When you hand it in <Alan speaks in a whisper.> Don't you think it is a little suspicious to be carrying elegant robes in broad daylight to a man garbed in dark leathers? Well, ahem, fortunately I am out here on behalf of the Kirin Tor, so there is no shady transaction about to take place. None at all. The robe, please.

94248.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Blue Overalls, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Oh! Please keep your voice down--we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves. Do you have something for me? When you hand it in The Blue Overalls! Thank goodness, I have a proper change of clothes. Take this, and please be on your way. I do not have time to chat, I must keep an eye on the farm and can't risk more distractions.

94249.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Azure Silk Hood, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back AHHHH! Oh, it just a ‹race›. Hi ‹race›! When you hand it in It da hood me order-er-ed! Me forgot why wanted in first place, but me take anyway. Here, take shiny coin. It fell out of slime monster. Lots and lots of them!

94250.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Small Silk Pack, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Yo! Is that pack for me? When you hand it in Ha ha! Thanks, pal. I owe you. <Kzixx reaches into a Small Silk Pack already in his possession, filled to the brim with coin, and pulls out a fist full. He counts out a tiny fraction of his total wealth, and hands it to you.> This should cover it. No take-backs!

94252.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Red Woolen Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Yo! When you hand it in When I worked for the Venture Co, I had to wear these boots all day, every day. I thought I would be able to take these off and get comfortable in my own hut, but I didn't think of it until after I tracked mud everywhere. These boots? They look way more comfortable. Second best thing to running around barefoot!

94253.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Colorful Kilt, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Keep ya' head down, mon! Dey be watching... When you hand it in I plan to be sneakin' into the gates of Zul'Gurub soon, but I need the gear to blend in. Thinkin' I gear up like one of their ritualists. This colorful kilt is exactly what I be needin'.

94254.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Greater Adept's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back <Magus Tirth begins to cast Polymorph: Chicken on you.> When you hand it in My new robe! Delightful! At long last, I can don my robe AND my wizard hat.

94255.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Spider Silk Slippers, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +75 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +75 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Yo! When you hand it in Are these my new boots? <Kixxle looks very excited, but it fades immediately upon setting his eyes upon them.> Ah. I thought I had cancelled the order for slippers once I realized how foolish it would be to trudge around a swamp with my toes hanging out. I ordered a new pair of proper boots too, but they still haven't arrived yet. Oh well, pleasure doing business with you. I'll keep these for later!

94256.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Frost Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94257.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Invisibility Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94259.desc: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Nature Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.> Rewards You will receive: Coin Pouch +125 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority +125 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics When you come back Have you come to aid the Emerald Circle? When you hand it in We are in dire need of more of these potions here in Felwood. Though there are many corruptive forces at play here, nature itself is known to lash out violently when provoked.
