94373.desc: Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself.. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path. But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave. Bring me two of their necklaces they wear--crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future. When you come back Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys - slow and stubborn, like a true ‹race›. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole. Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear. When you hand it in Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. I'll craft ye a sapta now - accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.

94497.desc: Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives. We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh. When you come back I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye--but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found. When you hand it in Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one. Still, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water. Thank ye for this sacred offering. It marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.

94499.desc: Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls. Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort. When you come back The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em. When you hand it in Aye, this is good water, ‹name›. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed prove you're ready for the next stage of your journey. One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.

94500.desc: Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water. It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric. Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over. And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink. When you come back Do you have the water yet, ‹name›? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful. When you hand it in Well done, ‹name›! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, ‹name›. Ye've done ‹class› proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.

94615.desc: I've got no idea what happened to our horses. I got up one morning to feed 'em and they were all gone, just like that. Life outside Farholde's a bit rougher. Anything could've got 'em--animals, murlocs, orcs, you name it. If we wanna narrow down our list of culprits, we oughta search around the stables for clues.

94879.desc: You've seen the ruined city to the north, yes? Sunnyglade? Demar tries sending troops, but we're no closer to reclaiming it. I have a better idea. In truth, this attack by the Twilight's Hammer is not the first. They seem to be coordinating from a centralized location, and I would know where. While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.

94923.desc: <Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.> Psst! Hey <mister/miss>, I need your help! My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was! It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself! Rewards Money: 20 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,150 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

94931.desc: The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal. If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.

95041.desc: Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files. It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover. The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot... When you come back How is the data retrieval progressing? When you hand it in These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, Archnatum!

95065.desc: What a view... Best an old man can ask for. The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go. Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: 5 Brilliant Smallfish 5 Rainbow Fin Albacore Money: 5 0 gold, 5 silver, 0 copper Experience: 900 When you come back Did you get the fishing supplies? When you hand it in Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here! Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?

95123.desc: As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we? I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it. The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.

95156.desc: Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle. If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with. I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.

95184.desc: The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran. I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death. If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there. Rewards Money: 20 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,850 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

95212.desc: We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles. Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm! When you come back You look chilly, ‹class›. How goes the hunt? When you hand it in These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, ‹class›!

95213.desc: The keg is stamped: BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later. When you come back What's that you've got? When you hand it in <The ‹race› turns pale as he sees the empty keg.> ...Where did you find this?

95214.desc: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it. When you come back I hope you've got good news for me? When you hand it in That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, ‹class›. Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.

95319.desc: Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill. Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses. I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.

95426.desc: Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie. Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans? Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.

95561.desc: <The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.> Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help. Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her. Rewards You will receive: 5 Goldenbark Apple Experience: 1,450 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

95568.desc: You have arrived on Mount Hyjal at a time of changes, stranger. You may have seen that the landscape is scarred by the old war and tainted by fel energies. For Hyjal to survive, nature must bloom again. If you are willing to help me gather seeds from some of the untainted plants, I would be grateful. Many flowers grow in the wild lands east of here. Look for small red or yellow flowers.

95569.desc: The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young. For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.

95613.desc: While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain. If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me. If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare. Rewards Money: 30 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,150 +25 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

95816.desc: Greetings, accomplished craftsperson! Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth! Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing. Happy crafting! Rewards Money: 9 0 gold, 9 silver, 0 copper Experience: 650

95924.desc: Ye there! Aye, I'm talkin' ta ye! We've made the discovery of a lifetime down in Un'Goro! Can ye believe it? There's just one problem... our dig site's been overrun by voracious beasts of the killin' nature. Very unpleasant indeed. With yer help, we can reclaim our camp and git back ta workin'. Now, what do ye say? I'll make it worth yer while. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Diemetradon Scale Spaulders Ravasaur Hide Footpads Money: 90 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper Experience: 17,650 +100 reputation with Ironforge +50 reputation with Stormwind

95943.desc: G'day, <lad/lass>. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service. <Bertrand extends a filthy hand.> These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools. Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'. Think ye could help find me tools?

95975.desc: Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking... Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future? Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.

96009.desc: One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'. But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood. With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us? Rewards You will receive: Lumber Luggers Experience: 2,150

96010.desc: Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis. Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.

96084.desc: I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water. I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.

96252.desc: ‹class›, I would ask a favor of you. One that is deeply personal. When they ambushed and killed my sisters, the Wormwings took their jewelry claiming these treasures as trophies of battle. What's worse, they've stashed our treasures in their nests with their unborn young; further proof of their depravity. Please collect my fallen sisters' treasures. Avoid harming the unhatched eggs if you can, but I'll lose no sleep over the broken eggs of our enemies. Rewards You will receive: Highfeather Bangle Experience: 3,100

96262.desc: I've known these hills since I was a hatchling. If there is one thing I know, it's that pinecones can solve a lot of problems. Probably not what you expected, eh? <The crow winks at you, conspiratorially.> Go fetch me some; it's part of a little scheme I'm hatching. I promise you it will be worth the effort. You should be able to find them under any healthy or living tree nearby. Stay away from those corrupted ones though, those pinecones aren't any good!

96264.desc: So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing. If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power. Earth's rumblin', ‹name›. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.

96335.desc: Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something! While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain? If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me. I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do. When you come back What do you say we cut the chit-chat and focus on getting me out of here! When you hand it in It feels good to get those shackles off. I can't even remember how long it's been. Now I just need an Inn, a shower, a shave... and the feel of a suit. Maybe a haircut, too. Feeling a little grungy.

96390.desc: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow. Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there. When you hand it in These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs. Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.

96392.desc: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem. If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick. When you come back Farsight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see. When you hand it in So ye see now, ‹class›? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky. Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?

96629.desc: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, ‹class›. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire. Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp. When you come back A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp. When you hand it in With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it. Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires. You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96782.desc: It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield. From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does. The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all. Rewards Money: 40 0 gold, 40 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,800 +100 reputation with Ravenholdt

96992.desc: You know, they packed enough tools to get the essentials started, but there's never enough fastening material. Only so much cordage-winding my hands can take. Resourcefulness is even better than being prepared. Take an empty bag to the burned-down remains of the alliance buildings around the Cradle of Tranquility southwest of here, and fill it with as many nails and brackets as you can find in the ashes.

97017.desc: Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye? These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys. So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one. Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Brown Ram Gray Ram White Ram Experience: 1,550 +25 reputation with Ironforge

97046.desc: Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of your first mechanostrider! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders. As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your strider will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one. Go examine the mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Red Mechanostrider Blue Mechanostrider Green Mechanostrider Unpainted Mechanostrider Experience: 1,550 +25 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles

97277.desc: Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life! Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off. Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches. Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it! Rewards You will receive: Canvas Latchbag Experience: 410 +75 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles +75 reputation with Ironforge When you come back Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home! When you hand it in Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'! Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet. Thanks, ‹name›. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.

98208.desc: I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people. My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home. Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders! Rewards You will receive: Bouquet of Auberdine Flowers Money: 25 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,350 +100 reputation with Darnassus

98231.desc: Miss Melly got burned pretty bad by those whelps. I think they scared her. I haven't been able to convince her to move! Listen, I have an idea. I once bought this snake oil potion that obviously didn't work as intended but it DID heal a cut I had. One of the active ingredients was supposedly an herb called Wyrmtail that's found around these parts. If my hunch is correct that might help Miss Melly's burns. Go see if you can find some and bring it back! Anything is worth a try. Rewards Money: 65 0 gold, 65 silver, 0 copper Experience: 3,750 +100 reputation with Gadgetzan

98246.desc: I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon. They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything. Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest. Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

98247.desc: <A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain. "Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel." Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.> When you come back Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance? When you hand it in You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels. When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started. Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?

98293.desc: The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed. Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.

98319.desc: It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here. If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid. Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some the beasts while yer at it. When you hand it in Ach, the fool... Thank ye for the help, Samo. Guess we have our report.

98321.desc: Hoha! Good to see a ‹race› who's not afraid to get their hands dirty. If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled! Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble. Rewards Money: 45 0 gold, 0 silver, 45 copper Experience: 625 +100 reputation with Ironforge +100 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles When you come back Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece! When you hand it in Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!

98326.desc: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it. Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway. Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast. Rewards You will receive: Frosthowl's Footwarmers Money: 3 0 gold, 3 silver, 0 copper Experience: 775 +100 reputation with Ironforge +100 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles When you come back It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo. When you hand it in Yer a real lifesaver, Leif! My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.

98895.desc: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance! Rewards Money: 45 0 gold, 45 silver, 0 copper Experience: 1,500 +150 reputation with Theramore Expeditionary Force

98897.desc: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance! Rewards Money: 70 0 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper +150 reputation with Theramore Expeditionary Force

98899.desc: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance! Rewards Money: 90 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper Experience: 6,400 +150 reputation with Theramore Expeditionary Force

98901.desc: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance! Rewards Money: 90 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper Experience: 6,600 +150 reputation with Theramore Expeditionary Force

99159.desc: My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could. I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks. When you come back Light guide you on your tasks. When you hand it in Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry. Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.

99160.desc: You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up. These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer. When you hand it in I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.

99161.desc: I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasionally weather changes and other minor slides. I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you. Rewards You will receive: Avala's Binding Experience: 700 When you come back 'Ware the winter, friend. When you hand it in Light bless you, ‹class›. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.

99162.desc: Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives. After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge. When you come back What do you need? When you hand it in The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.

86611.desc: <The pool of fetid slime has eroded the statue of the stag. It is unclear how it arrived here at the bottom of the lake. A single crystal stone set in a medallion around its neck bears an unwholesome green gleam. It is worth taking to someone who might know the history of this monument.> Rewards Money: 40 0 gold, 40 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,800

86614.desc: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D."> Rewards You will receive: Repurposed Hair Band Money: 12 0 gold, 12 silver, 0 copper Experience: 1,550 +100 reputation with Ironforge When you come back I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick? When you hand it in My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good! This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.

87318.desc: Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there! I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive! Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!

need: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
87491.desc: Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit! Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN! No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly! Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL! Rewards Money: 30 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,550 +100 reputation with Ironforge When you hand it in That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it! Glad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!

88812.desc: I fear time may soon forget the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest. A lone, crumbling, monument is the only surviving proof of their presence here. The monument can be found atop the cliffs at the very tip of the southern peninsula. Spitelash enchantresses there have a set of power stones which they use to channel their magic. Take this ward, and nullify them. This will cripple the Spitelash's magic, and give us an upper hand in driving them out. While you're at it, be sure to take out a few naga yourself. Rewards Money: 85 0 gold, 85 silver, 0 copper Experience: 5,650 +100 reputation with Darnassus

88821.desc: While scouting along the cliffs of the Shattered Strand, one of our sentinels noticed a kaldorei woman on the beach. Clearly, she is not with our expedition, and she did not have the makings of a fighter. I wonder then, what she could be doing in such a hostile place as this. If you can, try to make contact with her. I would like to know her purpose for being here, and if our interests are perhaps aligned. She was last seen on the eastern coast, along the north side of the Bay of Storms.

need: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment
88857.desc: <The sentinel speaks in a low whisper> Listen, ‹class›, before they hear us. I am a sentinel from Talrendis Point. The satyr here believe me injured, but I am only feigning; waiting for the moment they drop their guard and I can escape. Your arrival is perhaps such a moment. Help me out of here, would you? Rewards Money: 50 0 gold, 50 silver, 0 copper Experience: 4,200 +100 reputation with Darnassus

need: See what Saria has to show you
89053.desc: I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, ‹name›, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology. Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear. To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me? Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Highborne Memory Crystal Highborne Research Tablet Staff of Archmage Selwyn Experience: 5,650

89470.desc: <With Saria's true intentions revealed, and a bag of powerful artifacts in hand, perhaps now would be a good time give Commander Truesong her report.> Rewards Money: 85 0 gold, 85 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,800 +100 reputation with Darnassus

90487.desc: ‹name›, I have little more to offer. If you mean to make the long trek up the mountain, you might do well to speak with some of its ancient caretakers. Follow the road to the west. Look north, toward the foot of the mountain. You will eventually see an outpost, a remnant of the guardians that once roamed the slopes. There is an ancient there named Fraxinus. He and his friends can assist you.

91697.desc: Thank you for helping gather bear berries. Small steps build trust! With the aroma of berry resin on you, the Elders should be more welcoming of you. Go and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker.

91881.desc: With the warlocks under control, I'd say this area's well in wing. <The crow nods sagely, looking pleased.> Though our work here is done, there are other areas that could use your help and as an underwing of mine I would like you to go see what all the fuss is about. Follow the path northwest up the road to the old tern outpost. An old friend awaits!

92100.desc: <A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.> You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then? It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years. <The veteran glances at his surroundings.> Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.

92111.desc: I see you try, and try is more than most. We give you good will with time, if you do the same. Enter our den and talk to Osi. She has open paws, will give you more chance to help.

92743.desc: As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown. Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.

92818.desc: WE NEED MORE WEAPONS. MORE. WEAPONS. HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS? I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES. HURRY UP. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Plans: Hard Gold Gauntlet Plans: Iron Morningstar Money: 18 0 gold, 18 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,050 +1,000 reputation with Magram Clan Centaur 0 reputation with Gelkis Clan Centaur

92841.desc: It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it! Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul. You will know when you get there. You will know when you see him. If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know. And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.

92847.desc: Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal. I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.

need: Pouch of Tomb Dust thrown into the sea behind Stromgarde
92872.desc: We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls. Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom. Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles. Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.

92873.desc: We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons. <Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.> I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Blade of the Magram Clan Staff of Revelations Desperate Barrier Experience: 2,450 +500 reputation with Magram Clan Centaur 0 reputation with Gelkis Clan Centaur

92893.desc: As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive. This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.

92894.desc: I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet? Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further. As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic. I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!

92914.desc: <You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals. Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon. A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being. Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.> Rewards Money: 30 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 3,600

92959.desc: This corruption... seeps into my limbs, my roots. I am not the only one. Other ancients... have felt this corruption as well. One of my oldest friends... Sunderbark... the corruption has broken him, made him a creature of rage and pain. It is... too late to save him, now. Go to the corrupted pool to the east... strike the corrupted tree and he will come. Take this seed... and plant it in his remains when the deed is done. With care... something good can still grow from this sorrow. Rewards You will receive: Sunderbark Vigil Experience: 7,300

93016.desc: You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance. I will gladly answer your questions.

need: Escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway
93125.desc: You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help. I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent! Please help. Rewards Money: 45 0 gold, 45 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,700 +500 reputation with Gelkis Clan Centaur 0 reputation with Magram Clan Centaur

93129.desc: Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway. Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too. When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!

93341.desc: As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived. I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine. The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened. When you hand it in <Mithera listens quietly to your explanation of the situation.> The pedestal is empty? My necklace is... missing? <A great sadness washes over her expression.> I should have expected as much. The quilboar and the centaur have been ravaging these lands for such a short amount of time, but the damage they have already done is immeasurable. ‹name›, even if the magic is gone from the necklace, I am clinging onto hope that I may have it back. Would you be willing to help?

93383.desc: A sturdy backpack stuffed with survival equipment and radio receivers lies between prickly bushes. There's a flashing indicator light on one of the radios. You reach for the bag and the radio strapped to the backpack buzzes to life. "Pilot present! Gnomal Positioning System establishing uplink! Confirming contents to dispense: Aviator's Survival Kit, Three Day, One Size, Quantity One Please stand by while security mechanism discharges safely before opening." Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Rocket Pilot Gloves Rocketeer Leggings Rusty Propeller Blade Experience: 1,500

93394.desc: I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good! The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble. With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.

need: Lost One slain (10) Lost One Hunter Lost One Seer Lost One Lost One Muckdweller Lost One Riftseeker
93429.desc: Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred. There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives. Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain? Rewards Money: 35 0 gold, 35 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,750

need: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage
93585.desc: Oh thank goodness, someone civilized! I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all! However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, ‹class›?

93615.desc: Oh, a tasty morsel... Fear not, I jest. Though I could snap your spine like a dry branch. I am a demigod of the wilds, after all. If you would gain my favor and avoid my appetite, perhaps I could burden you with a task? My litter of young have wandered off to entertain themselves. Little on this mountain could threaten them directly, but there are dark things afoot near the summit, and I'd leave nothing to chance. Would you check on them? In return for my not eating you, of course. Rewards You will receive: Claw of Shalla'kal Experience: 4,500

93747.desc: The old hulks of the war are decaying and rusting, but we can speed the process of reclamation. Take this bag of the seeds that you collected before. I have given them a small helping of magic to speed their growth. Place them near the old war machinery and let them grow over and cover them. The memories of the war will fade into the past and nature will reclaim its space.

93791.desc: ‹name›, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own. Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands. When you hand it in Ah, you must be ‹name›? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.

94479.desc: Picking up the rusting metal, you see another, shinier, engineering component. It looks like anything else of use has been picked clean. Perhaps somebody nearby recognizes this part or who might want to salvage it.

94484.desc: A moment if you will, ‹name›. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue. With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease. When you hand it in Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent? <Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.> So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then. It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

94493.desc: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent? <Elegael pales as you explain yourself.> So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straights indeed then. <Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.> Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence. When you hand it in The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain. Please, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.

94504.desc: Some may speak with you now, but not all. For more of our tribe to be what you know as friend, you must not rush. Stay by our side, work with our young and old, and guard us from those who wish us harm. When you have more to bring to us, we will have more to share.

94613.desc: Our warhorses come from two nearby farms. One of them, owned by the Wheeler family off the road just outside of town, has apparently lost all of their stock. The cause of this is currently unknown. With no horses, we have no cavalry, and without cavalry, our campaign against the Horde stands no chance. Thus, you see, this situation must be resolved with utmost haste. Of where to start, however, I am less sure. Go to Wheeler's Grange and speak to Benjy. See what he has to say for himself.

94618.desc: From what you found, it seems like the coyotes got most of the horses. Still, there's a few not accounted for. Those that didn't get eaten probably ran off scared someplace. I don't know how many of those horses there are, but we'd better find 'em before the coyotes come back. <Benjy holds out a sack in front of you.> Here. If you find one, give it some of our feed. That'll get it to trust you so you can lead it back here.

94829.desc: If you've come to demand more of our crop, you're too late. No doubt you saw my farm. Destroyed. All of it. Good folk toiled in these fields for years to feed troops and civilians alike. But when those cultists arrived, where was the military? Where was our promised protection after all the rations they'd taken from us? If you've any sense of decency, I beg you. The least we can do is recover their belongings from those cursed raiders. Let my people rest with their kin in the graveyard to the west.

94843.desc: Considering you got yourself wrist-deep in guts and manure for us, it's only right you get to do the fun part too. The boys and I gather seeds from the trees as we work. With the fertilizer you've provided, I've made a planting kit to put them in the ground to grow new saplings. Take it, and find some good planting spots around the work sites.

94857.desc: Stranger, listen to me! I work as a lumberjack for the nearby logging camp. As you can see, I've been trapped here in an accident. If I don't get out from here soon, I'll either bleed out, or be eaten by wild animals. Please, go to the logging camp and fetch help! When you hand it in My brother's where?!

need: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.desc: Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year. Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Curly's Chopper Hurley's Felling Axe Experience: 3,000 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse When you hand it in That damn kid... Even if he is a knucklehead, Curly's a good worker. Hopefully he heals up fine and learns some sense. Things could've gone a lot worse if you hadn't been there. Thanks for looking out for him.

94884.desc: I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos. I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest. When you come back You look like you found something extra delicious. Come come, show me what you have. When you hand it in You found Claire, did you? How lovely. Her instincts were correct, I'm glad you brought this to me. I guess the Twilight's Hammer didn't expect such a direct response. I'll have to thank them later for supplying these marvelous reagents.

need: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok
94927.desc: When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight. Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Dunston's Ogre Duster Bolder'ok Loincloth Prisoner Handwraps Experience: 4,650 +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

94928.desc: These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast. When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for. When you come back Whaddya got for me? When you hand it in Cornelius ain't delivering these himself anymore? Thank goodness! Couldn't stand that guy. <Friz inspects the contents of the bundle.> Looks satisfactory. Tell your people at Farholde to keep 'em comin'.

94963.desc: Come, ‹race›. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds! Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward. Rewards Money: 50 0 gold, 50 silver, 0 copper Experience: 3,150

need: Escort the lost horse to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.desc: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.> Rewards Money: 20 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,850 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse When you hand it in Thanks for savin' my Biscuit! You're a real friend, ‹name›. It's bittersweet knowin' she'll be all alone for awhile, but hopefully we'll find a few of her stable-mates before long. Next time you see ol' Demar, let him know Wheeler's Grange is back in business!

94999.desc: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here. He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation. I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch. I'm sure you understand.

95066.desc: The message we've delivered is clear. Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress. Rewards You will receive: Orc Bone Bow Experience: 1,500 +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

95165.desc: So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator! The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?

95260.desc: The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be? The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.

95293.desc: Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people. Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.

95294.desc: Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day. Run along back to your master, ‹class›. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.

95316.desc: Alright dirtwalker, you may have noticed the combination of pinecones and fel-infused slime is quite disgusting, if you ask me. It is, however, also very dangerous-- which is just what we need! Take these pinecones and carefully--I repeat, carefully--make your way to the nearby warlock encampment. Once there, use these items to wreak havoc upon their precious workstations. I am sure the results will be amusing for you to watch firsthand! This should certainly slow them down. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Crowfeather Tunic Bristlecone Cloak Experience: 6,000

95320.desc: There is a caged demon just up the road near the entrance of the demon caster encampment that has been making a great deal of fuss. All this ranting and raving about imprisonment and freedom. Something about scorching bones and revenge? <The crow leans in and gives you a mischievous look. As if to emphasize, she then dangles an iron key in one of her talons.> Let's see if we can't make a deal with our little 'friend' and see what he knows about these nasty demon casters.

95322.desc: Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for. But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course. They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh? When you hand it in Venture Co? And the trunk was empty? Those rotten cheats stole my money! I knew dealin' with those good-for-nothin' pirates was bad for business! Nobody goes back on a deal with Ruzzgot and gets away with it.

95611.desc: One cannot take without giving in return. This is the cycle of life. You have done well, ‹name›. Thanks to your efforts, the wildlife on the mountain will continue to thrive. Now, it is time we show our respect for these lands by offering the unused remains back to the ground. Take this bundle and visit the shrine to the west. You shall recognize it as a simple pair of standing stones. Return to me once the ritual is complete. Rewards You will receive: Staghide Drape Experience: 1,450

95615.desc: If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out. Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Sacristan Band Verger Greaves You will also receive: Warding Candle Experience: 2,150 +50 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

need: Crystal Catalyst filled (25) Empowered Brute Twilight Ritual Circle Twilight Ritualist
95642.desc: You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me? No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what. It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, ‹class›. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest. When you come back Be careful around the big ones. They may seem simple, but they are powerful sorcerers in their own right. When you hand it in <Claire flinches as she touches the crystal crackling with cultist magic.> This is more potent than I ever feared. We'll need to handle this with care.

95753.desc: <The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. It appears to be offering you a challenge. Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.> Rewards Money: 30 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper Experience: 1,950

95983.desc: The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery. You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.

96018.desc: You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured. We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find. The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.

need: Shen'dralas wildlife slain with the blade (8) Blind Screecher Prowler [DNT] Kill Credit: Shen'dralas wildlife slain with the blade Bear
[DNT] Kill Credit: Shen'dralas wildlife slain with the blade
96060.desc: Let me be the first to share that I was a master swordsman in life. I forged weapons by day and wielded them by night. As you are quite well aware, my relationship with this particular blade is now extraordinarily complicated. Though I think I could swing it around, I'm not convinced it would be of much use unless I was fighting other spirits. Is that really of any value to me in Shen'dralas? Nonetheless, I would like its capabilities tested and I think our forests could use a gentle culling. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Phantasmal Shiv Spectral Magister's Commission Greatsword of Great Pasts Experience: 3,450

need: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
96067.desc: You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine. I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected. Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!

96125.desc: Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break. At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing. Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return. Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.

96131.desc: I'm sure you've met that old stick-in-the-mud, that lives in the cave south of here? You must take this staff to him along with my feather. He will know what it means. Or he won't! Either way it will get his attention. He may be an oldstone, but he is reliable. He's one of the few mortals I would trust with a matter as grave as this. Quickly, Dirtwalker! I fear a shadow is falling over Hyjal we cannot see.

96145.desc: Traveler, be wary! Though the Shrine of Aviana lies ahead, the area is claimed now by the harpies of the Wormwing tribe. Like my family, the Highfeathers, I am a follower of Aviana, but the Wormwings are not so loyal. They are a danger to anyone who passes through their territory. If you can make your way past them, my cousin Phoebe Highfeather helps to protect the shrine.

96321.desc: I... don't have much time, mortal. You must take this staff, a branch of the world tree... corrupted... wrong. I carried it here... The Wild Gods... they must know. Take it to her. The... crow... <The dying Wild God grows still and his eyes stare blankly ahead. What little is left of his corporeal form seems to break apart and drift away. There is a faintly glowing branch on the ground, with a sickly green crystal affixed to its head.>

96559.desc: Every Gnomish test pilot knows that one must be prepared for the worst-case scenario when taking to our great skies! That's why we never leave the hangar without our pilot survival kits. They have a self-activating beacon attached that will radio our position home as soon as you open it. Not to mention being stuffed full of other useful supplies. If you can find that pack wherever it fell, by all means open it immediately and help yourself to the contents. You'll still be doing me a favor!

96796.desc: This looks like something that the tinker in the hills, Kaylaena, could make use of. She barely visits ever since the loss of her mentor, Yaely. Look for her workshop in the hills to the north. After Archimonde's fall in the great battle, the two of them scavenged what they could easily bring back themselves, picking many of the machines on these foothills clean. Putting this debris to new use is better than allowing it to rust here. Your errand helps new life sprout where it was choked by metal.

96798.desc: Sergeant Danneth was last seen on patrol with his squad near Serpent's Coil, just south of Nethergarde Keep. One of the members of his squad stumbled back into the keep, badly wounded and claiming that the entire squad was killed or captured. That soldier died a few hours later, unfortunately. We don't have confirmation that Danneth is dead, but chances aren't good. I can't spare the men to push into the cult's lair, but if you wanted to go and look for the man, I'd not refuse the aid. Rewards Money: 80 0 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper Experience: 5,450 +100 reputation with Kirin Tor

96799.desc: <Lieutenant Connar listens as you tell him the reason you are here.> So, Danneth has an orphaned nephew in Dalaran? If you haven't spoken to him about this yet, I'd suggest you do so. He doesn't exactly seem like the parenting type, but he might surprise me. If he does want to go and collect the boy once he's recovered, he has my blessing to take leave for that. Rewards Money: 40 0 gold, 40 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,700 +100 reputation with Kirin Tor

96811.desc: I think I'm ready now. Let's get going when you are ready. Rewards Money: 80 0 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper Experience: 5,450 +100 reputation with Kirin Tor

96959.desc: War. By the time I heeded the call of our clans, the battle had passed, and only ashes answered my blade. My purpose is forged anew. This mountain remembers strength--ancient power riding its winds and holding its water. I would earn the right to walk its spine, to reach the fallen stronghold that lies upon the road to the summit. Demons profane these graves. Before I fight at your side, I must know you stand capable. Light the two bonfires and return to me. Their flames draw our enemy out.

96979.desc: I am a druid of the Circle, walking the long path to honor the great world tree. I misjudged how much the climb would ask of me, and the winged hunters that haunt these slopes have made caution a necessity. These old ruins offered shelter, and I accepted it. This place is suitable for a humble offering, yet no ritual should be given without living water. If you would, fill my gourd at the falls ahead. When you return, speak to me of the trail you walked, and of what stirs upon it.

96983.desc: You're capable, fast, fearless. Fire will draw the demons from their hiding places, and with them, their warlords. They will come seeking dominance. Instead, they will find vengeance waiting. This is the moment where the will of the mountain speaks through us. Come, let us carve a path through these hellspawn and end their reign. My blade yearns to cleave through their ranks. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Polished Doomguard Edge Yashiro's Spirit Bead Experience: 8,300

97331.desc: Wait, wait, don't go yet! I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here! You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh? Rewards Money: 35 0 gold, 35 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,750

97536.desc: The Matter Transporter required experimentation to get right. Many tests were conducted on all sorts of materials... with various outcomes! Some of the results are no longer with us. Others have become dangerously charged! These subjected objects emit an energy that burns if you stay near for too long. Almost like they've been charged with a year's worth of the desert sun's power. Take this Crate of Radioactive Refuse and empty the contents in the sand a safe distance from town and other trash.

97540.desc: Oh, this fresh water smells so good... I'm going to stop for a moment and have a quick swim and a drink.

97663.desc: I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later. The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache. Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself? Rewards Money: 25 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper Experience: 3,150

98027.desc: <The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before. Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?> Rewards You will receive: Replica Crescent Necklace Money: 25 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,350 +100 reputation with Darnassus

98221.desc: In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded! They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil. Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next! Rewards Money: 25 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper Experience: 2,300 +100 reputation with Ironforge When you hand it in Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition! What he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.

98223.desc: This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan. Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons. It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council." Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Flamescarred Spellbook Dragonmaw Buckler Experience: 1,250 +75 reputation with Ironforge

98230.desc: After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol. It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish. It didn't last long, sadly. Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand. When you hand it in If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.

98240.desc: Word is officially out on those whelps, ‹name›. We already have an order in! I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise! These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar. Rewards Money: 50 0 gold, 50 silver, 0 copper Experience: 1,200 +50 reputation with Stormwind When you hand it in These are perfect. Thank ye for making the journey.

need: Escort Lynessa Duskblossom out of Ban'ethil
99053.desc: My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here. I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal. I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Ban'ethil Quiver Sentinel's Slasher When you hand it in Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend. Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.
